title: Uncollected Pieces: Holding Periods, Storage Charges and Abandonment by Service Level
content:
# Conditions of the Work Order: Uncollected Pieces, Storage Charges and Abandonment

When your piece is finished, the Belrose Workshop Repair and Resizing Service holds it for you without charge for the holding period your service level sets. After that period storage is charged for each started month, and after the level's abandonment threshold the piece falls under the chain's lien.

| Level figure | Standard Bench Service | Priority Bench Service | Master Jeweler Service | Heritage Restoration Service | Designer Authorized Repair Service | Atelier White-Glove Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Holding period before storage is charged, calendar days | 30 | 30 | 45 | 60 | 60 | 90 |
| Storage charged for each started month after the holding period, USD | 15.00 | 15.00 | 25.00 | 35.00 | 35.00 | 60.00 |
| Piece treated as abandoned after, calendar days from completion | 180 | 180 | 270 | 365 | 365 | 365 |
| An abandoned piece may be disposed of under the chain's lien | yes | yes | yes | no | no | no |

## Conditions

1. The holding period runs in calendar days and is counted from completion. A finished piece left uncollected past that period carries the level's storage charge for each started month — a month begun is a month charged.
2. The abandonment threshold runs in calendar days from completion: 180 at Standard Bench Service and Priority Bench Service, 270 at Master Jeweler Service, and 365 at Heritage Restoration Service, Designer Authorized Repair Service and Atelier White-Glove Service.
3. Disposal of an abandoned piece under the chain's lien is permitted at Standard Bench Service, Priority Bench Service and Master Jeweler Service. At Heritage Restoration Service, Designer Authorized Repair Service and Atelier White-Glove Service disposal is not permitted.

## Hypothetical timeline

Take a hypothetical Master Jeweler Service piece finished on day 0 and still uncollected. Nothing is charged for storage through day 45. Collected on day 46, it has entered the first started month after the holding period and carries one month at 25.00 USD; collected on day 80, it stands in the second started month and carries 50.00 USD. Were the same piece still uncollected on day 270, it would stand at the level's abandonment threshold.
